records.exactText: Prepare against a charge, leap, forced movement, or door breach.

records.exactText: Combat uses feet or 5-foot spaces. Movement can be split around actions and attacks. Difficult terrain costs 2 feet per foot. Severe terrain costs 3 feet per foot and may require a check.
records.priorQuotedText: Combat uses feet or 5-foot spaces. Movement can be split around actions and attacks. Difficult terrain costs 2 feet per foot. Severe terrain costs 3 feet per foot and may require a check.

records.exactText: Forced movement does not provoke opportunity attacks unless a feature explicitly says it does. Falling, flowing water, conveyor mechanisms, gravity changes, and living dungeon surfaces are common sources of forced movement.
records.priorQuotedText: Forced movement does not provoke opportunity attacks unless a feature explicitly says it does. Falling, flowing water, conveyor mechanisms, gravity changes, and living dungeon surfaces are common sources of forced movement.

records.exactText: You can move through a nonhostile creature's space (it's difficult terrain). You can only move through a hostile creature's space if it's at least two sizes larger or smaller than you. You cannot willingly end your move in another creature's space.
records.priorQuotedText: You can move through a nonhostile creature's space (it's difficult terrain). You can only move through a hostile creature's space if it's at least two sizes larger or smaller than you. You cannot willingly end your move in another creature's space.

records.exactText: Creatures occupy space from Tiny (2.5x2.5 ft) to Gargantuan (20x20 ft or larger). Most player races are Medium (5x5 ft). A creature's space is the area it controls in combat.
records.priorQuotedText: Creatures occupy space from Tiny (2.5x2.5 ft) to Gargantuan (20x20 ft or larger). Most player races are Medium (5x5 ft). A creature's space is the area it controls in combat.

records.exactText: A creature can squeeze into a space one size smaller than itself. While squeezing, movement costs 1 extra foot per foot moved, attack rolls and Dexterity saves have disadvantage, and attacks against the creature have advantage.
records.priorQuotedText: A creature can squeeze into a space one size smaller than itself. While squeezing, movement costs 1 extra foot per foot moved, attack rolls and Dexterity saves have disadvantage, and attacks against the creature have advantage.
